'''Noa Essengue''' (born December 18, 2006; {{IPA|fr|nɔɑ əsɛnɡe}})<ref>{{cite AV media |publisher=Skweek | title=Noa Essengue: A dream in the making |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a61WzIk6-Ok |date=16 November 2024 |time=00:00:30 |via=YouTube}}</ref><ref>{{cite AV media |publisher=Goatoguy | title=Get to know - Noa Essengue |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ox3a-9friY0 |date=5 April 2024 |time=00:00:16 |via=YouTube}}</ref> is a French professional [[basketball]] player for [[Ratiopharm Ulm]] of the [[Basketball Bundesliga]] (BBL).

==Professional career==
Essengue was born in [[Orléans]] and played for the youth department of [[Orléans Loiret Basket]] as a child.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.larep.fr/orleans-45000/sports/noa-essengue-pepite-du-basket-originaire-d-orleans-convoque-en-equipe-de-france-a-17-ans_14581451/|title=Sports - Noa Essengue, pépite du basket originaire d'Orléans, convoqué en équipe de France à 17 ans|work=[[La République du Centre]]|date=October 17, 2024|access-date=October 30, 2024|language=French}}</ref> He began his professional career playing for [[Centre Fédéral de Basket-ball]], a team affiliated with [[INSEP]], in [[Nationale Masculine 1]] (NM1).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bebasket.fr/noa-essengue-entre-lasvel-et-ulm-noah-manet-vers-lyonso|title=Noa Essengue entre l'ASVEL et Ulm, Noah Manet vers LyonSO|first=Gabriel|last=Pantel-Jouve|website=BeBasket.fr|date=June 9, 2023|access-date=October 30, 2024|language=French}}</ref>

Essengue signed with [[Ratiopharm Ulm]] of the [[Basketball Bundesliga]] (BBL) on July 21, 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bebasket.fr/le-prospect-noa-essengue-choisit-ulm-plutot-que-lasvel|title=Le prospect Noa Essengue choisit Ulm plutôt que l'ASVEL|first=Alexandre|last=Lacoste|website=BeBasket.fr|date=July 21, 2023|access-date=October 30, 2024|language=French}}</ref> He spent most of his first season assigned to [[OrangeAcademy]], Ulm's developmental team.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.swp.de/sport/sport-ulm-alb-donau-kreis/orange-academy-in-der-pro-b-essengue-energie-reicht-nicht_-ulmer-verlieren-ueberraschend-73212593.html|title=Essengue-Energie reicht nicht! Ulmer verlieren überraschend|first=Christian|last=Kern|work=[[Südwest Presse]]|date=March 3, 2024|access-date=October 31, 2024|language=German}}</ref>

==National team career==
Essengue was named to the [[France men's national under-18 basketball team|France under-18 national team]] to compete in the [[2024 FIBA U18 EuroBasket]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/nba-draft-noa-essengue-ben-saraf-and-ratiopharm-ulm-s-orange-campus|title=NBA Draft: Noa Essengue, Ben Saraf, and Ratiopharm Ulm's 'Orange Campus'|first=Andrew|last=Bernucca|website=[[SI.com]]|date=August 20, 2024|access-date=October 30, 2024}}</ref> He was named to the [[France men's national basketball team|senior team]] for France's [[EuroBasket 2025 qualification|EuroBasket 2025 qualifier]] matches against Cyprus.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Basket/Actualites/Equipe-de-france-la-premiere-liste-de-fauthoux-avec-nolan-traore-et-noa-essengue/1514280|title=Équipe de France : la première liste de Fauthoux avec Nolan Traoré et Noa Essengue (Bleus)|work=[[L'Équipe]]|date=October 17, 2024|access-date=October 31, 2024|language=French}}</ref>
